summary.text: Bobby Guerra is a member of the Texas House of Representatives for District 41, which includes McAllen, Mission, Edinburg, Palmhurst, Lopezville and Pharr, first elected in 2012. His official biography says he chairs the Resolutions Calendars Committee and serves on the Energy Resources Committee.

paragraphs.text: Guerra was born in Edinburg, Texas, in 1953, graduated from Pan American University in 1977 and was a television reporter and news anchor at KRGV-TV before earning a law degree from Texas Southern University in 1985.
He practices law as a founding member of Guerra & Sabo, P.L.L.C.
He was elected chairman of the Hidalgo County Democratic Party in March 2000 and served two terms, and was president of the University of Texas-Pan American Alumni Association board in 2003.
He has been married to Leslie-Yoder Guerra since 1979 and they have three children.
